test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

The captain explained that the ship had been sailing for three weeks and they had faced a severe storm the previous night.

options.text: The captain explained, "The ship was sailing for three weeks, and we faced a severe storm last night."
The captain explained, "The ship has been sailing for three weeks, and we had faced a severe storm last night."
The captain explained, "The ship has been sailing for three weeks, and we faced a severe storm last night."
The captain explained, "The ship had been sailing for three weeks, and we faced a severe storm last night."

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. The captain explained, "The ship has been sailing for three weeks, and we faced a severe storm last night.".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech**, where the speaker reports what someone else said without quoting their exact words.
 
• To convert it into **direct speech**, the exact words of the speaker must be quoted, with proper tense and context preservation.
 
• In the indirect sentence: - "The ship had been sailing for three weeks" refers to a past perfect continuous action. - "They had faced a severe storm the previous night" also uses past perfect tense for a completed action.
 
• In direct speech, the tenses will remain the same to maintain the original meaning: - "The ship has been sailing for three weeks." - "We faced a severe storm last night." (Changing "they" to "we" and "the previous night" to "last night" for direct speech).

Correct sentence: *The captain explained, "The ship has been sailing for three weeks, and we faced a severe storm last night."*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indirect Speech to Direct Speech Conversion Rules:**
 
 
• Change pronouns appropriately (e.g., "they" → "we").
 
• Adjust time expressions (e.g., "the previous night" → "last night").
 
• Maintain the original tense of the sentence to preserve meaning.
 
 
 
• **Tense Overview in Reported Speech:**
 
 
• Past Perfect Continuous changed to Present Perfect Continuous in direct speech.
 
• Past Perfect is simplified to Past Simple for clarity in some contexts.
